test_results.Bonus: Edit existing role Role Type prel: OBSERVATION — When editing 'Manger(C)' role, the [data-testid='role-type-select'] preloaded to '' (empty). This suggests either the existing role has no roleType set OR the roleTransform.fromAPI is not mapping the roleTypes field on GET. Not part of BUG-198 scope, but worth verifying that roleTypes round-trips correctly on edit.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Verify that roleTransform.fromAPI.role() maps roleTypes (or role_type_list) from API so an existing role's roleType preloads when editing. Currently editing 'Manger(C)' shows Role Type as blank.
critical_code_review_comments: EmployeeListView.jsx L21: `showPassword` is a single boolean shared across ALL rows (new + existing). Clicking any eye toggle flips the visibility of every password field simultaneously. Acceptable for a batch-edit grid but potentially confusing UX — consider per-row `Set<id>` state so toggles are independent.

EmployeeListView.jsx L91-121 saveAll(): New employees are created sequentially in a for-loop with await, and if any one fails partway, earlier successes are already persisted while later rows still show as 'new' (green background) — no rollback, no per-row error surfacing. Consider Promise.allSettled with per-row status like ExpenseBulkEditor uses.

EmployeeListView.jsx L228 vs L293: New row placeholder is 'Password *' while existing row placeholder is 'New password'. Intentional (new requires password, existing is optional). Minor inconsistency worth documenting in a tooltip.

employeeTransform.js L43-54 updateEmployee: When user clears an email field on an existing employee (from 'foo@x.com' → ''), the transform silently drops email from the payload (omit-if-empty). Backend will therefore never receive the intent to clear. If the intent is 'clear email', this is a bug; if 'omit unchanged fields' is the semantic, it works. Consider explicit null vs empty-string handling.

RoleFormView.jsx L18: `roleTypes: role?.roleTypes || []` — verify roleTransform.fromAPI maps this field. If backend returns `role_type` or similar, existing roles will always load with roleType=blank (observed in test).
axios.js L48: `window.location.href = '/'` on 401 — hard nav loses in-memory state (unsaved employee edits). Consider react-router navigate() or a toast prompting the user to log back in.
EmployeeListView.jsx L104: On new employee create, the password is sent as-is to backend. Ensure backend hashes it — this is a shared responsibility check.
seed_data_creation: NONE — no data was persisted to production. All state-changing actions (add employee row, edit name, fill role form) were reverted or cancelled before save. Verified no lingering 'TEST_' rows on the tenant.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BUG-198 is fully verified on cafe103 preprod. All 10 review items PASS. Note the app route is /employees (not /employee-management as stated in the review request — the review request had wrong route; correct route is at App.js L166). One observation for main agent: editing existing role 'Manger(C)' shows Role Type dropdown as blank — possibly a roleTransform.fromAPI mapping gap, not a BUG-198 regression but worth a quick look. No save operations were executed against roles/employees in production. All 41 API requests included X-localization=en header. PUT is now used for /vendoremployee/edit-employee/{id} and /vendoremployee/role-update/{id} per code review (not exercised via UI to preserve prod data).
